fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Plaque hardens into calculus within days, and once it does no toothbrush will shift it. A professional clean removes it, then we work on the habits that slow it coming back.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We check gum health, measure pocket depths where needed, and note recession or bleeding points. This tells us whether you need a routine clean or gum treatment.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: An ultrasonic scaler uses high-frequency vibration and water to break calculus off the tooth surface, above and just below the gum line. It tickles more than it hurts, though sensitive areas can be numbed.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A polishing paste lifts surface stain and leaves the enamel smooth, which slows plaque re-forming. We floss through every contact afterwards.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Five genuinely useful minutes on brushing angle, whether floss or interdental brushes suit your gaps, and a fluoride application where it helps.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If pockets are deeper than 4mm or bone has been lost, a routine clean isn’t enough. Periodontal treatment goes deeper, under anaesthetic, over more visits.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some people build calculus quickly or have a history of gum disease. Three or four monthly cleans for a period often works better than fighting it twice a year.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If your goal is whiter teeth, a clean removes surface stain and is the sensible first step - sometimes it’s enough on its own.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: No treatment is risk-free, and you should hear this before you decide rather than afterwards.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Cleaning does not remove healthy enamel, but it does expose root surfaces that calculus had been covering, which can feel sensitive for a few days.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: If gums are already inflamed, they may bleed during and briefly after the appointment. That is a sign of existing disease, not damage from the clean.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A clean treats the symptoms of poor plaque control, not the cause. Without daily cleaning between teeth, calculus returns within months.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Where gum disease has already destroyed bone, a clean stabilises rather than reverses it. The lost bone does not grow back.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Very heavy staining from smoking or tannins may not lift entirely in one visit.

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Tell us if you have a heart condition, joint replacement or immune-suppressing medication - occasionally antibiotic cover is advised beforehand.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Most health funds cover two examinations and cleans per calendar year, claimable on the spot through HICAPS. If you’re a new patient, a scale and clean is included in the $199 or no-gap first visit. Eligible children can be bulk billed through CDBS.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Before anything starts you’ll have a written treatment plan with costs, inclusions and any conditions spelled out, plus an estimate of your health fund rebate checked at the desk.
